supplemental:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create sixth OpenCut design board in exactly the attached family: restrained charcoal surfaces, turquoise accents, thin outline icons, crisp Simplified Chinese, flat desktop editor panels. High-resolution landscape2560x1600. Title "06 / 边界、确认与恢复" right "设计稿 · 状态示例". Six equal well-aligned panels in3columns×2rows, all text legible, no device perspective. Professional dense interface, not marketing.
TOP LEFT title "01 不兼容落点". Show two mini timeline lanes video and audio with lock and eye icons. A photo drag ghost above an AUDIO lane with red prohibited cursor, red dashed outline and tooltip "视频不能放入音频轨道". Beneath second example a transition ghost above gap between two video clips with red outline; tooltip "片段不相邻，无法添加转场". At bottom external caption "拒绝落点，不修改工程；松开后返回资源区".
TOP MIDDLE title "02 替换已有转场". Mini timeline two adjacent photo clips with selected teal crossfade at seam; new crossfade ghost hovering exactly over existing seam; tooltip "替换交叉淡化 · 保留0.50秒". Beneath small comparison "当前：交叉淡化 0.50秒" → "替换：交叉淡化 0.25秒". However make tooltip say "替换为0.25秒" to match new duration. Clear footnote "仅替换所选接缝，不移动相邻片段；可撤销". No confirmation dialog for reversible replacement.
TOP RIGHT title "03 拖放提交与失败". Stack three compact separated states of the same clip ghost: first label "拖动中" dashed turquoise outline and text "Esc取消 · 不保存"; next "保存中" small spinner on outlined placed clip, text "正在保存此次修改"; third error bar "未保存，已回到修改前" small secondary "查看原因" and primary "重试". Footnote "一次放下对应一次修改；重试前重新核对目标". No fake successful project mutation implied.
BOTTOM LEFT title "04 恢复项目版本". Real compact confirmation dialog "恢复到此版本？" close×. Version label "海岸慢行 · 今天14:25", not mp4. Summary 3 short rows "将恢复：3条轨道 · 7个片段" "当前未保存操作：无" "恢复后可撤销". Tiny coast preview optional. Buttons "取消" and primary "恢复版本". Exact short explanatory sentence "当前工程将恢复为该版本的内容。". No download and no destructive-red styling for reversible restore.
BOTTOM MIDDLE title "05 从素材库移除". Compact confirmation "移除素材引用？" photo thumbnail and filename "海边漫步.mp4". Critical body exactly "此素材正在被2个片段使用。" below "保留时间轴片段，仅从素材库隐藏。" Design chooses safe hide/unlist behavior, do not claim delete underlying source. Actions "取消" and "从素材库隐藏". Small secondary link "查看使用位置". External caption "删除片段 ≠ 移除素材引用；源文件不受影响". If text potentially unsupported still design only.
BOTTOM RIGHT title "06 键盘与短片段". Two media cards default and keyboard-focused; focused card has high-contrast focus ring, hovering-equivalent + and ellipsis visible. Compact shortcut legend "Enter 预览" "Shift+Enter 插入" "Esc 返回时间轴". Beneath 20px short timeline clip with visible trim handles, magnification callout shows expanded hit areas; separate nearby transition seam target. Caption "焦点显示操作；手柄与接缝不抢命中". Add small property editing strip value72 changed to80 with caption "Enter确认 · Esc还原".
Footer small statement "以上均为设计状态；实际开发需验证事务、撤销和恢复行为". Panel padding12px, row height32, 8px gaps, 6px radius. Do not add arbitrary unsupported new features, cloud uploads, downloads in history or giant empty cards.

revisions.prompt: Edit this exact OpenCut UI design image. Preserve ALL layout, typography, colors, photographs, controls and spacing. Make only these surgical corrections for temporal semantics: In the right-hand "片段信息" inspector, set 入点 to "00:00:00", 出点 to "00:12:12", 时长 to "00:12:12", which at25fps describes the ~12.48second selected timeline segment. The media library source duration remains00:15, as the source is longer than the trimmed timeline instance. Do not change ruler, selected clip geometry, playhead, or total42seconds. In all timeline track headers, replace closed-lock icons with OPEN padlock icons; tracks are editable. Replace the bottom caption with "资源浏览 · 时间轴编辑 · 属性调整 | 轨道按类型分组，合成顺序在图层中调整". Preserve top annotation "01 / 工作台总览", design/sample label. This is a UI design revision, not a new composition. Crisp Simplified Chinese, high resolution, no additional panels.

Edit this exact six-panel OpenCut resources design board. Preserve overall layout, colors, card previews, and typography. Only correct these issues: (1) Remove the isolated + button at the top-right of the 特效 panel entirely. For 片段效果 active mode, use a small text action "应用" inside the hovered third card lower-right instead of a checkmark; tooltip "应用到：海边漫步". Selecting the inactive 效果图层 tab is the explicit way to add an effect layer, not an ambiguous top +. (2) Remove the isolated disabled "应用" button and its tooltip BELOW the font cards. Instead show the disabled "应用" control INSIDE the lower-right of the last loading font card and tiny tooltip "字体加载中". Keep the real hovered font's enabled 应用 inside its card. There must be NO buttons beneath font cards. (3) In 转场 hovered third card replace checkmark with small text "应用" WITHIN lower-right; keep tooltip明确接缝. (4) In 图形 category bar change selected "基础形状" to "全部"; other tabs become "形状 国旗 标记", so the existing mixed grid is valid. (5) Default文字 card gets small + INSIDE lower-right only; this plus explicitly creates text; other font cards use应用. Do not change Chinese names or unrelated content, spacing, panel positions. Preserve all five card-state miniatures and bottom rules. Sharp readable Chinese, exact UI fidelity.

Edit this exact OpenCut timeline design board. Preserve all panel layout, controls, colors, Chinese labels, compact inspector and lower examples. Fix timeline geometry: In the large top video lane, the first coastline clip must span exactly ruler00:00 to00:10, and the boat clip must start exactly at00:10 and continue to00:20. Their photo filmstrips MEET flush with ZERO GAP at the 00:10 ruler tick. Make the transition badge a semi-transparent narrow OVERLAY centered on that seam, not a standalone segment that takes timeline space. Photos must remain visibly continuous underneath badge; widen its invisible pointer hit zone only with a fine dashed outline if needed. The ghost resource and "释放以添加转场 · 0.5秒" tooltip above stay. Inspector shows first clip00:00–00:10, second00:10–00:20. The ruler must align start and end exactly. White playhead staysat8s. Change closed locks to OPEN locks on editable tracks everywhere except the "锁定轨道" example, which retains closed lock. Do NOT change any other content. Preserve selected transition appearance and readable Chinese.

(1) LEFT bottom saved-project-version preview: replace title "海岸慢行.mp4" with "海岸慢行 · 项目版本". Keep today14:25, read-only preview, return-current and restore controls. Edit this exact OpenCut boundary/recovery design board, keeping its six-panel layout, dark style, icons, typography and all content except these safety and scale corrections. TOP RIGHT third state currently "提交失败/未保存，已回到修改前/重试" must instead depict uncertain network result: state label "结果待确认"; orange/amber status instead of red; message "连接中断，正在核对保存结果"; actions "检查结果" and "详情"; DO NOT offer重试 while result unknown. Add small line under it "确认未提交后，才允许重试". Update footer under this panel "一次放下对应一次修改；结果未确认时先核对". TOP MIDDLE timeline currently first0–8second second8–16second but ruler mismatch; simplify ruler labels to00:00atfirststart,00:08atexactflushseam,00:16atsecondend; photo clips must meet with no gap beneath transition OVERLAY. Keep replacement0.50to0.25seconds. BOTTOM RIGHT short clip duration is too short to label00:04–00:04; replace this label with "短片段示意". Keep expanded hit areas instruction. BOTTOM LEFT restore dialog and BOTTOM MIDDLE hide-library reference must remain unchanged and clearly distinguished from download/deletion. At bottom of TOP LEFT add a very compact empty-library variant separated by thin line: folder icon, "暂无素材", tiny button "导入素材", text "也可拖入文件"; do not squeeze existing invalid-drop examples. No additional errors or overlap, Chinese exact, preserve layout.
